# `function` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/function.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

One logical element (doc 03 §7, rank 32): a pole set, a contact, a coil, a PSU, an interruption point.
Its connection points are instantiated from the definition or the part's pattern; only overrides are
stored. `device` is `None` if and only if the kind is `Ip` (ADR-0006 amendment 1).

Not in v0: `CpOverride.closure` (fluid ports, doc 03 §15).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `function` |
| File | `devices/<xx>.jsonl or pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 32 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`function.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/function.schema.json) |

## Types

### BusPort

The `BusPort` aspect of a function (doc 10 §2.7, FR-BUS-001): a bus interface of a device or a connector. Ports
derive network properties such as the rate from their logical net and never copy them (FR-BUS-002).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | [`AddrValue`](#addrvalue) | yes |  | The station address: a value, the typed open item `tbd` (prints "TBD", blocks release, EW-BUS-001) or `not_applicable` (a port without an address: a passive connector). |
| `bus` | [`BusSystem`](#bussystem) | yes |  | The bus system. |
| `interface` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The interface name ("DP", "X1"). |
| `logical_net` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) or `null` | no |  | The logical net: the scope of address uniqueness, rate and master (FR-BUS-002). |
| `physical_net` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) or `null` | no |  | The physical net whose derived segments the port belongs to (FR-BUS-003). |
| `port_label` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The port label of a multi-port interface ("P1R"). |
| `role` | [`PortRole`](#portrole) | yes |  | The port's role. |
| `termination` | [`OnOff`](#onoff) or `null` | no |  | The termination switch of a connector or device port (FR-BUS-004); absent: the port has none. |

### AddrValue

An address value (doc 10 §2.7, §3.8): a value, a typed open item, or no address.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A set address.

   Shape: object { `value`: [`NetAddress`](#netaddress) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `value` | [`NetAddress`](#netaddress) | yes |  | A bus address (doc 10 §2.7). Format 0.1 types the PROFIBUS station address; the address forms of the other buses (PROFINET name and IP, EtherCAT position, …) are kept verbatim as `NetAddress::Unknown` until WP-S1.24. |

2. **Form 2**: "To be defined": prints "TBD", appears in the open items and blocks release (EW-BUS-001, FR-CHK-034).

   Shape: `"tbd"`

3. **Form 3**: The port has no address (a passive connector, an IO-Link device side).

   Shape: `"not_applicable"`

### CpOverride

An override of one instantiated connection point (FR-DEV-008).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alias` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Alias ("1 / L1"). |
| `description` | [`MlText`](#mltext) or `null` | no |  | Description. |
| `designation` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Printed designation. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The CP index. |
| `unused` | boolean | no |  | Unused by design. |

### FnRole

Main or auxiliary function.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"main"` | The main function (the default). |
| `"aux"` | An auxiliary function. |

### FunctionKind

The kind of a function.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: An ordinary function (the default).

   Shape: `"normal"`

2. **Form 2**: An interruption point.

   Shape: object { `ip`: [`IpSpec`](#ipspec) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `ip` | [`IpSpec`](#ipspec) | yes |  | An interruption point (doc 03 §10). |

3. **Form 3**: A black box whose CPs come from the part's pattern.

   Shape: `"black_box"`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### NetAddress

A bus address (doc 10 §2.7). Format 0.1 types the PROFIBUS station address; the address forms of the other
buses (PROFINET name and IP, EtherCAT position, …) are kept verbatim as `NetAddress::Unknown` until WP-S1.24.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A PROFIBUS station address (nominally 0–125, a range from data, FR-BUS-009).

   Shape: object { `profibus`: integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `profibus` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) | yes |  |  |

### OnOff

A two-state switch (doc 10 §2.7: the termination of a connector, FR-BUS-004).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"on"` | On. |
| `"off"` | Off. |

### PortRole

The role of a bus port (doc 10 §2.7).

| `"master"` | A bus master (PROFIBUS DP master). |
| `"slave"` | A slave. |
| `"controller"` | A controller (PROFINET IO controller). |

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
